    Audit unequal-random-intercept calibration across independent batches

    audit_unequal_random_intercept_calibration.Rd

    Uses exact unique treatment assignments within cluster-size strata and a separate Monte Carlo approximation. Batch seeds are separated by one million to prevent the overlapping per-iteration streams that make adjacent-seed summaries appear artificially stable. Gaussian, heavy-tail, unequal- allocation, and deliberate dispersion-violation scenarios are included.

    audit_unequal_random_intercept_calibration(
  batches = 20L,
  simulations_per_batch = 500L,
  permutations = 99L,
  engine_checks = 10L,
  cluster_sd = 1,
  residual_sd = 1,
  alpha = 0.05,
  seed = 20260719L,
  keep_results = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    batches

    Number of independent seed batches.

    simulations_per_batch

    Null simulations in each batch and scenario.

    permutations

    Monte Carlo assignment draws per simulation.

    engine_checks

    Number of first-batch Gaussian datasets also passed through the complete distance engine with exhaustive permutations.

    cluster_sd, residual_sd

    Generating standard deviations.

    alpha

    Rejection threshold.

    seed

    Base reproducibility seed. Batch seeds are spaced internally.

    keep_results

    Retain simulation-level p-values.

    Value

    A Phase 14 exact-randomization calibration audit.
